metadata.title: Close adversarial PTY harness evidence gaps

work.objective: Close three adversarial correctness gaps in the accepted PTY harness snapshot: event-to-sync coverage, stubborn descendant cleanup, and final override parameter binding.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths for every read, edit, search and command.
Only modify scripts/tui-parity/**; do not modify product code, dependencies, lockfiles, Marshal state, commit, push, publish, use network access or start subagents.
If an operation is denied, do not retry that path; use an allowed equivalent or report blocked.
All three adversarial counterexamples must become regression tests; passing existing tests is insufficient.
context: Successor to qwen-otui-evidence-recovery-r2-20260811. A delayed independent review found three P1 blockers after that Run was prematurely accepted; this Run must produce new snapshot and verification evidence before the harness can be trusted.

DEC2026_EVENT_COVERAGE: runner.mjs currently compares dec2026.begin >= events.unique plus balance, without associating events to active sync intervals. Three empty begin/end pairs followed by three unwrapped OSC697 events passes. Parse or derive actual per-event synchronized coverage; unwrapped events and empty sync pairs cannot prove coverage. Tests must place markers inside/outside intervals accurately and README claims must match measured semantics.

TIMEOUT_STUBBORN_DESCENDANT: capture.mjs schedules SIGKILL, but finish/settle clears all timers when the main child closes, cancelling escalation. A descendant that ignores SIGTERM and detaches stdio survives. Keep escalation alive or explicitly await/confirm process-group cleanup. Add a bounded fixture, and native PTY coverage where reliable, with a descendant that ignores SIGTERM and does not hold capture stdio.

OVERRIDE_PARAM_BINDING: scenario validation checks scenario commands before runner.mjs replaces them with --base/--fixed overrides. Divergent final argv can execute while the report says compareParams were validated. Validate the final resolved argv and terminal dimensions after overrides, or bind a stable checked fingerprint. Add CLI override mismatch tests.
Preserve already verified native PTY allocation, TTY/rows/columns evidence, scripted input, refusal, handshake, normal timeout and artifact behavior.
nonGoals: Do not modify OpenTUI/Ink product code.
